corrections.fact: Shaman reward12 is Wishka's Favor; Glacial Avalance is a source typo for Avalanche
Paladin Brell seventh, Wave eighth follows the contemporary 2008-05-03 report and maintainer acknowledgement. A later 2013-12-01 report reverses them and is outside the target cutoff.

limits: Dialogue paraphrased; original spell order/identities retained.
TSS minimum71 follows quest metadata; active level is checked.
Underfoot gem exchange is fixed by gem identity, independent of class or already learned state.
Existing lootdrop rows exist for all57 gems. Exact Live probabilities and all drop-zone distributions are not established. No loot probabilities are changed.
Underfoot rankI missions, SoD exchange/NPC and other unresolved acquisition remain separate.
